proposal.generationPrompt:
Limit the intended declutter change to exactly one compact, clearly decorative, opaque tabletop object and only its attributable short local shadow. The complete object and shadow must be distinguishable on a simple continuous matte receiver, without overlap, reflective dependencies, open holes, or uncertain foreground ordering. No qualifying object is unambiguously established in this capture; leave the scene unchanged rather than choose a substitute or infer unseen details.

Do not remove the transparent flower vase or foliage on the blue island, the grouped countertop canisters, the knife block, shelf ornaments, or unresolved items on the distant dining and living-room tables. Preserve every other object and every permanent finish. Retain the wood cabinets, blue speckled counters, pale backsplash, stainless-steel refrigerator and sink, faucet, pendant lights, white doors and trim, windows, railing, fireplace, seating, rugs, plants, and adjoining rooms. Preserve existing countertop and appliance highlights, window reflections, ceiling illumination, and unrelated shadows. Do not flatten a patterned or reflective finish into matte material to make an object eligible.

Maintain the original full 2:1 equirectangular sphere, camera position, horizon, orientation, wrap, and poles. Keep projection curves and the existing nadir camera/support artifact unchanged; do not invent polar texture.

Preserve blue-counter speckling and highlights, refrigerator and sink reflections, window glazing, lamp highlights, adjacent objects, and every fixed finish.
